=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:591-593 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `Broker._run_log_tail` calls `self.gh([f"repos/{self.repo}/actions/jobs/{fields['job']}/logs"])` without `--allow-escape-sequences`, so `gh api` refuses Actions job logs that contain ANSI escape sequences.
  WHY: The repo documents this gh behavior (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1692-1699), and every other job-log reader passes the flag. For colour-coded logs, which are the common case, gh exits non-zero, `Broker.gh` returns None, `partial` is set and the planner gets `(unavailable)` instead of the 4 KiB tail, while the call still uses up an API-call slot. All reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high); openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave confidence 5. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash also filed it under SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION, without a severity. The suggested fix is `self.gh(["--allow-escape-sequences", f"repos/{self.repo}/actions/jobs/{fields['job']}/logs"])`; `gh_api_retry.endpoint()` skips leading `-` args.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:334-358 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `assemble()`, the trailing `if omitted: out += f"({omitted} answers omitted: byte cap)\n"` note is appended without a size check, which three reviewers say can push the output past `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_BROKER_MAX_BYTES` by about 45 bytes.
  WHY: This would break the docstring contract "Host note plus fenced answers, never over cap bytes", and the journal's `evidence_hash` would then cover output larger than the cap. There is no crash and the overshoot is bounded. Severity was NIT (mapped to low) from all three. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagrees and explicitly rejected this claim: with reserve = 64 (line 342), output never exceeds cap - 64, and the note is at most 31 bytes, so it always fits.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:lines 591-592, in Broker._run_log_tail: raw = self.gh([f"repos/{self.repo}/actions/jobs/{fields['job']}/logs"]) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The job-log read goes through gh_api_retry.call, which runs "gh api -i <path>" without --allow-escape-sequences. gh refuses ANSI-coloured job-log bodies without that flag (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 1692-1695; scripts/check_triage_resolution.py lines 468-471). Every other reader passes the flag: workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1698 and 2765, workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:62, orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20264, check_triage_resolution.py:471.
  WHY: With PERSIST_EVIDENCE_BROKER_ENABLED=true, gh exits non-zero, Broker.gh returns None and the planner gets "(unavailable)" instead of the promised last 4 KiB. The call still costs 1 of the 10 API calls and sets broker.partial. Fix: self.gh(["--allow-escape-sequences", f"repos/{self.repo}/actions/jobs/{fields['job']}/logs"]); this is safe because gh_api_retry.endpoint() (lines 93-105) skips leading "-" flags, and _clean/_CONTROL_RE plus redact_secrets already neutralise escapes. Also update test_github_kinds_make_one_optional_call_each in tests/test_evidence_broker.py: fake_call keys responses on args[0], so it should key on the endpoint instead. (Duplicated in HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS, estimated 1 line in the script and about 2 in the test; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.)
- Note (not a finding): this reviewer rejected the pass-1 claim that assemble() can exceed the cap (scripts/evidence_broker.py lines 355-356): reserve = 64 (line 342), the note is at most 31 bytes, and the header is about 650 bytes, below the MIN_MAX_BYTES of 1024.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. P11 items 1-5 were checked against docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md lines 565-585.

  PROBLEM: The trailing note is appended unconditionally, contrary to the docstring "never over cap bytes", even though the loop reserves 64 bytes.
  WHY: At MAX_BYTES=1024 with ten refused-heavy answers, the output can exceed the cap by about 45 bytes, and `evidence_hash` then covers an over-cap result. There is no crash.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:`_run_log_tail`, line 592 — `raw = self.gh([f"repos/{self.repo}/actions/jobs/{fields['job']}/logs"])` | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: (SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION) The job-log request is issued without `--allow-escape-sequences`. `gh_api_retry.call` runs `gh api -i <args>` verbatim (scripts/gh_api_retry.py:420). The refusal is documented at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1692-1693, scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1049-1051, scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:468-471 and scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.sh:62.
  WHY: gh exits non-zero, `Broker.gh` returns None (scripts/evidence_broker.py:476-478) and the planner gets `(unavailable)`. Adding the flag is safe because `gh_api_retry.endpoint()` skips leading `-` args, and scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:471 uses the same shape.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:`_run_log_tail`, line 592 (same call site as the security-lens finding) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `run_log_tail` requests fail for any job log that contains ANSI escape sequences, because the call omits `--allow-escape-sequences`.
  WHY: gh rejects the body, `Broker.gh` returns None, `broker.partial` is set and the second planning run proceeds without the evidence.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:`assemble()`, the closing `if omitted: out += f"({omitted} answers omitted: byte cap)\n"` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The trailing note is appended unconditionally and can exceed `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_BROKER_MAX_BYTES` by about 45 bytes, contradicting the docstring and the agents.d fragment's byte-cap contract.
  WHY: At the minimum cap of 1024 with many oversize answers, `evidence_hash` covers an over-cap output. There is no crash and the overshoot is bounded.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): (1) add `--allow-escape-sequences` at `_run_log_tail` line 592, 1 line, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5; (2) append the note only when `len(out.encode("utf-8")) + len(note) + 1 <= cap`, 3 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
